title: Marvelous Designer - Videos
description:
Updates, tutorials, and art showcases from the leading 3D garment design and simulation software, Marvelous Designer.

Built on over a decade of research in precise textile simulation, Marvelous Designer is the industry’s go-to for creating realistic 3D garments — trusted by AAA game studios, major animation and VFX studios, and independent artists alike. Its pattern-based design tools and advanced textile simulation technology enable users to create, customize, and visualize digital garments with true-to-life fabric behavior. 

Recognized with a Scientific and Engineering Award from the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, Marvelous Designer has helped define some of the world’s most iconic media. As part of the CLO Virtual Fashion family, we’re committed to advancing digital garment technology and expanding its impact across creative industries worldwide.
